title: For Zuzu
body: Kol sana wenty tayeba I hope you're balling out on your first birthday as a free adult.

Have fun in Zutopia. We had fun building it these past few months. Stay tuned as we continue to update this world. Gradually, of course. IRL, AA Studios live life one acai bowl at a time, how life is meant to be lived.
We hope you have an awesome day with family and friends (and colleagues?? wow I can't believe I am saying that). You deserve it. And of course, a blessed 23 inshAllah...
- Asser (CEO and Founder of AA Studios)
